items.name: NxNs in November - Ōtautahi 2025
items.information:
NxNs in November - Ōtautahi 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.name: Penn Cube Day Fall 2025
items.information:
* We will be giving out free Penn Cube Day hats for competitors.

* Current UPenn students are entitled to free registration. Please leave your Penn email in the registration comment and pay the fee. We will refund if you are qualified.

* We will have newcomer (competitors attending their first competition) podium for 3×3, based on the result of 3×3 round 1.

* We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event.

* Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

* Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the main room. You may eat elsewhere in Houston Hall. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk/drive.

* Live results will be posted on WCA Live.

items.information:
This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will go towards supporting West Coast Cubing and the Cal Cube Club.

## Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may bring a maximum of two guests.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
